data.name: Spoop Street
data.detailed_description:
SPOOP STREET is a cosy halloween style game, that you can play anytime. Explore, relax and search for treats, be it from TRICK OR TREATING, DIGGING, SOUL SEARCHING and many other MINI-GAMES!

Everyone plays differently, and the game will cater for all types of gaming moods, so no matter who you are, you'll find where you want to be.

-

Enjoy the adoring horrors on Spoop Street as you appear on the shore of the island, in search for your purpose.

Maybe it's to:

Make friends with the residents and you might learn some more about the island.

Play mini-games

Collect a huge variety of CANDY! SWEETS! CHOCOLATE! Whatever you call it!...And a few less than exciting items. 

Sell your goods for money to spend on UPGRADES, COSTUMES and EQUIPMENT

-

SOLO DEV NOTES

I created this idea playing PowerWash Sim with a friend. From a chat to concept, it has been long, but it's extremely exciting. My aim is to create a game that anyone can go into, and find an aspect of it to have a good time. It's all about fun *fingers crossed it delivers*

But I want to work with the community to make sure bugs are squashed, ideas are implemented, and most importantly you feel heard.

I'd love for you to support my journey, and I'll make sure I do what I can on my side!

With all the love, PLB x

PS. I would love for this to translate into an animated series like Adventure Time, Gravity Falls or Summercamp Island. But extra gloom! That's the dream, proud and true!

data.short_description: SPOOP STREET is a cosy halloween game for all. Explore, relax, and search for treats by playing mini-games. Sell the items you get to buy Upgrades, new Costumes and useful Equipment to venture into creepier locations for greater rewards.
